title: LawKAN: group-law layers for composition — when imposing a known law pays off (code and reproduction artifact)
description: Code and reproduction artifact for the LawKAN paper: a group-law layer for transformation composition (exact node, learned edge, zero-initialized law correction). Tested on SU(2), GL+(2,R) and SE(3); real robot-arm calibration, IMUs and a gyroscope. Includes 120 canonical blocks, 171 mechanical number checks, the span-check demo, and data/license manifests. Third-party datasets retain their own licenses (see THIRD_PARTY.md); ABB RobotCali is not redistributed.
